changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Registro inmutable de resoluciones de destinatarios del directorio (ARC-120): quien se resolvio, nunca su correo
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ( resolution_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, request_type VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, requested_by_module VARCHAR2(50 CHAR) NOT NULL, subject_user_id NUMBER, resolved_user_ids CLOB NOT NULL, recipient_count NUMBER NOT NULL, is_fallback_used CHAR(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR2(30 CHAR) NOT NULL, resolved_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, resolved_by_user_id NUMBER, resolved_ids_cardinalidad NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (JSON_VALUE(resolved_user_ids, '$.size()' RETURNING NUMBER NULL ON ERROR)) VIRTUAL, resolved_ids_solo_numeros NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_EXISTS(resolved_user_ids, '$[*]?(@.type() <> "number")') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_resolucion_destinatario_log PRIMARY KEY (resolution_id), CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_ids_json CHECK (resolved_user_ids IS JSON (STRICT)), CONSTRAINT fk_res_dest_subject_user FOREIGN KEY (subject_user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_res_dest_resolved_by FOREIGN KEY (resolved_by_user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas de coherencia del registro de resoluciones (REQ-081): enumerados, sujeto solo en INDIVIDUAL y cardinalidad
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_request_type CHECK (request_type IN ('INDIVIDUAL','COLECTIVO'))
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('OK','SIN_DESTINATARIOS','NO_ENCONTRADO','NO_NOTIFICABLE','ERROR_TECNICO'))
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_fallback CHECK (is_fallback_used IN ('Y','N'))
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_recipient_count_min CHECK (recipient_count >= 0)

ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_subject_iff CHECK ( (request_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_user_id IS NOT NULL) OR (request_type = 'COLECTIVO' AND subject_user_id IS NULL) )
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_sin_destinatarios CHECK (outcome <> 'SIN_DESTINATARIOS' OR recipient_count = 0)
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_cardinalidad CHECK (recipient_count = resolved_ids_cardinalidad)
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log ADD CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_solo_identificadores CHECK (resolved_ids_solo_numeros = 1)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_solo_identificadores
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_cardinalidad
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_sin_destinatarios
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_subject_iff
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_recipient_count_min
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_fallback
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_outcome
ALTER TABLE resolucion_destinatario_log DROP CONSTRAINT ck_res_dest_request_type
